angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 558,647 km at 187.30 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.3389 +/- 0.0102 mas (same row, RUWE 1.06): 187.30 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.803 +/- 0.016 solar radii from Collins et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Qatar-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153...78C/abstract): 558,647 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.838 +/- 0.043 solar masses from Collins et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Qatar-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153...78C/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5013 +/- 93 K from Collins et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Qatar-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153...78C/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Collins et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Qatar-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153...78C/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/qatar-1.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.552, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, Qatar 1: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Qatar-1 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.171 dex, from Collins et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153...78C/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Qatar-1 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.43771, from Collins et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153...78C/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Qatar-1 (pscomppars): age 1.19 Gyr, from Mislis et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015MNRAS.448.2617M/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Qatar-1 (pscomppars): rotation period 23.7 d, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
